_memo:
Internal memo — vinyl flooring negotiation, 2026-09-11:

No deal reached. Seller's final authorized offer was 150 units at $44/unit, free freight, net-30, shipping no earlier than day 40 — seller stated they cannot commit to the remaining 50 units, any price below $44, or delivery within 30–32 days without director approval, which was unavailable during this conversation. This fails both our price target ($42, ceiling $46 — $44 itself was within range, but only at 150 units) and our 32-day delivery requirement by a wide margin. Since it also does not beat the competing offer of $45/unit at 32 days for the full 200 units, we are proceeding with the other supplier. Nothing left open on our side; seller may re-engage if they secure director sign-off on quantity or timeline, but no follow-up is planned from us.
